articles.title: US seizes two more sanctioned oil tankers with links to Venezuela, military says
articles.summary: The US military seized two more oil tankers linked to Venezuela, enforcing international sanctions. This action highlights ongoing geopolitical tensions and the US strategy to pressure the Venezuelan regime economically. Such maritime interdictions demonstrate the strategic importance of naval power in upholding foreign policy and influencing global trade, reflecting key international relations dynamics.

articles.title: Delhi HC asks RBI about steps taken to enforce digital lending rules
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has directed the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to furnish details regarding actions taken to enforce its digital lending rules. This intervention highlights judicial scrutiny over financial regulation and the RBI's efforts to curb malpractices in the rapidly growing digital lending sector. It underscores the importance of regulatory oversight for financial stability and consumer protection in India's evolving economy.
